g.text: S2: SRule rewrites to SEq, after RuleFold
joins the literals of the rule.
S3 to S6: comparisons and logic become step.
S7: sigmoid becomes sig. S8: XNorm becomes ANorm.
S11 to S19: EMatMul, ET and the positional calls
become EJuxt, EIdx, AProj and ANorm.
